headline: Sensex jumps over 950 points, Nifty climbs above 22,500 led by strong rally in IT shares

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IT shares outperformed and led the market recovery, boosted by strong gains in TCS.
All sectoral indices turned green with IT jumping 3.3% and FMCG gaining 2.2%.
European stock markets rebounded as global oil prices eased.
Coal supplies to power plants rose 36% from September lows, easing energy concerns.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 950 points while Nifty traded comfortably above 22,500.
Zetwerk is planning an Indian IPO of up to $525 million next week.
A penny stock rallied 11% following a deal involving SAIL.
Non-metro markets emerged as key growth drivers for Amazon in India.
summary:
Indian stock markets surged strongly today with Sensex jumping over 950 points and Nifty crossing 22,500.
The rally was broad-based across sectors, led by significant outperformance in IT and FMCG stocks.
Global market sentiment also improved as European equities rebounded on easing crude oil prices.
